goal: Iske baad aap struct declare kar sakte hain, uske variables bana sakte hain, dot operator se members set aur read kar sakte hain, braces ya cin se initialise kar sakte hain, aur poore struct ki copy bana sakte hain.
warmup: Ek university admission form ka ek khali design chhapti hai. Design (form ka layout) koi student nahi hota. Jab koi student usay bhar de tabhi aap ke paas asli naam wala asli record hota hai. Struct declaration khali form ka design hai. Struct variable ek bhara hua form hai.
definition: Struct declaration C++ ko nayi type ka naam aur uske data members ki list batati hai. Yeh koi variable nahi banati aur memory use nahi karti. Structure variable us type ka ek variable hai. Uski har member ki apni copy hoti hai. Aap member tak dot operator se pohanchte hain: variable.member. Declaration semicolon par khatam hoti hai.
howItWorks: Step 1: struct ko declare karein, aam tor par main() ke UPAR, taake har function nayi type ko dekh sake. Step 2: main mein type ke naam se variables banayein, jaise Student s1;. Step 3: members ko read ya write karne ke liye dot operator use karein: s1.cgpa = 3.7; ya cout << s1.name;. Member bilkul apni type ke aam variable ki tarah chalta hai. Aap variable ko shuru ki values teen tareeqon se de sakte hain. Pehla, braces se member ke order mein: Student s1 = {1, "Ali", 3.5};. Doosra, variable declare karne ke baad ek ek member: s1.id = 1; aur isi tarah. Teesra, keyboard se seedha members mein parh kar: cin >> s1.id >> s1.name >> s1.cgpa;. Poora struct = se copy ho sakta hai: s2 = s1; har member copy kar deta hai. Copy ke baad dono variables alag alag hain, jaisa memory visual dikhata hai. Jo aap nahi kar sakte woh yeh hai ke poora struct ek hi baar mein print ya read karein (cout << s1 kaam nahi karta) ya do structs ko == se compare karein. Un ke liye ek ek member ka kaam karna parta hai (agla lesson). sizeof ke bare mein: sizeof(s1.id) int member ka size hai. sizeof(s1) poore variable ka size hai. Yeh kam az kam members ke sum ke barabar hota hai aur zyada bhi ho sakta hai, kyunke compiler members ke beech khali jagah daal sakta hai. Is liye kisi khaas number par bharosa kabhi na karein.
